---
title: Chicken with Truffle
id: MAR-0047
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 50
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 550 g boiled chicken breast
- 5 anchovy fillets
- 5 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 0.5 tablespoon mustard
- to taste juice of ½ lemon
- 50 g truffle
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Cut the chicken into fillets and place it in a bowl.
2. In a bowl, combine the chopped anchovy fillets, mustard, oil, lemon juice, a grind of pepper, and a pinch of salt.
3. Beat with a fork, mixing the ingredients well.
4. Pour the dressing over the chicken, mix, and finish with truffle slices.
